settings.heading: Every order earns something back.
settings.text: Join free, collect points on purchases and reviews, and trade them for products, early looks and shipping perks.
settings.image_alt: Member opening a points reward box
settings.tiers_heading: The more you shop, the more you unlock.

settings.title: Sign up
settings.text: Create a free account and get 100 points just for joining.

settings.title: Collect
settings.text: One point per dollar, plus bonus points for reviews, referrals and your birthday month.

settings.title: Redeem
settings.text: Spend points on full-size products or a mini of your choice at checkout.

settings.title: Member
settings.perks: Points on every order · birthday gift

settings.title: Insider
settings.perks: Early access to launches · free shipping

settings.label: Do points expire?
settings.text: Points stay active for twelve months after your last purchase or review.

settings.label: Can I combine points with a promo code?
settings.text: Yes. Redeem points first, then apply any code to the remaining total.

settings.label: How do I check my balance?
settings.text: Sign in and open the rewards tab in your account, or see the banner in your bag.

settings.heading: Be first to see what's next
settings.message: Launches, members-only sales and the occasional how-to, once a week.
